title: 사투리 알아듣기: 어느 지역 말이에요?
objective: You can spot common regional endings and words, name the region, and give the meaning in standard Korean.
summary: This worksheet shows well-known Korean regional words and endings.
note: The list shows well-known forms; real speech changes from town to town and between older and younger speakers.

task.title: Find the region and meaning
task.line: Use the word list and the tips to name the region, choose the right form, or rewrite the sentence in standard Korean.

sections.heading: 표준어와 사투리: When do Koreans use which?
paragraphs: 표준어 (standard Korean) is based on the Seoul speech that educated people widely use. You hear it on the news, in exams, in official papers and in most textbooks. 방언 is the formal word for a regional dialect; in daily talk people usually say 사투리.
Many Koreans speak 표준어 at work and switch to 사투리 with family or hometown friends. Speaking dialect is not 'wrong' — it often sounds warm and close.

sections.heading: 자주 듣는 사투리 (Common regional words and endings)

items.text: Standard: 뭐 해? — Gyeongsang uses -노 for questions with a question word (뭐, 누구, 어디, 언제).
items.example: 지금 뭐 하노? 전화 좀 받아라.

items.text: Standard: 밥 먹었어? — -나 is for yes/no questions, and 묵다 means 먹다.
items.example: 밥 묵었나? 안 묵었으면 같이 가자.

items.text: Standard: 정말, 아주 — it makes the feeling stronger.
Standard: 단단히, 잘 — used when telling someone to be careful or not to forget.
Standard: -다니까 — the speaker repeats or stresses what they said.
Standard: 그것, 그 사람 — said when the right word does not come to mind.
items.example: 그 거시기 있잖아, 어제 만난 사람.

items.text: Standard: -요 — it sounds slow and gentle.
Standard: 어서 오세요 — you often see it on signs in Jeju.

sections.heading: 읽기 팁 (How to guess the region)
paragraphs: Look at the end of the sentence first: -노/-나 → 경상도, -당께 → 전라도, -유 → 충청도, -옵서예/-수다 → 제주도. Then change the ending back to the standard form (-노 → -어?, -당께 → -다니까, -유 → -요) and the meaning usually becomes clear.

exercises: Write the region (경상도, 전라도, 충청도, 제주도): ① 어디 가유? ② 니 언제 왔노? ③ 내가 다 했당께.
Fill in the blank with -나 or -노 (Gyeongsang): ① 숙제 다 했____? ② 누구랑 갔____?
Rewrite in standard Korean, keeping the casual style: ① 그 영화 억수로 재밌다. ② 아까 다 말했당께.
Read the text message and choose the meaning of 단디 — (a) quickly (b) carefully, without forgetting (c) later: 내일 비 온다. 우산 단디 챙기라.
You see this sign at an airport. Which region is it, and what is it in standard Korean? 혼저 옵서예
answers: ① 충청도 ② 경상도 ③ 전라도
① 그 영화 정말 재밌다. (아주/진짜/엄청 재밌다, 재미있다) ② 아까 다 말했다니까.
